info.title: Razorpay Products API
info.description: API specification for Razorpay Payment Links, Subscriptions, and QR Codes products.

basicAuth.description: Use your Razorpay Key ID as the username and Key Secret as the password.

contact.description: Phone number of the customer, including country code.

NotifyObject.description: Notification channels for sending the payment link to the customer.

sms.description: Send the payment link via SMS to the customer.

email.description: Send the payment link via email to the customer.

id.description: Unique identifier of the payment link.

accept_partial.description: Indicates whether the customer can make a partial payment.

amount.description: Payment link amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., paise for INR).

amount_paid.description: Amount paid against the payment link so far.

cancelled_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the payment link was cancelled. `null` if not cancelled.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the payment link was created.

description.description: A brief description shown to the customer on the payment page.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp after which the payment link will expire.

expired_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the payment link expired.

reference_id.description: An optional reference identifier you can set for internal use.

reminder_enable.description: Indicates whether payment reminders are enabled for the link.

short_url.description: Short URL of the payment link that is shared with customers.

status.description: Current status of the payment link.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the payment link was last updated.

user_id.description: Unique identifier of the Razorpay user who created the payment link.

amount.description: Payment link amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., paise for INR). Must be greater than 0.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Supported values include `INR`.

description.description: A brief description of the payment link shown to the customer on the payment page.

reminder_enable.description: Set to `true` to send payment reminders to the customer.

expire_by.description: Unix timestamp after which the payment link will expire. Must be at least 15 minutes in the future.

accept_partial.description: Set to `true` to allow the customer to pay a partial amount.

reference_id.description: An optional reference identifier for internal use. Must be unique per payment link.

expire_by.description: New Unix timestamp after which the payment link will expire.

reminder_enable.description: Enable or disable payment reminders for the link.

PlanItem.description: Details of the item associated with the plan.

active.description: Indicates whether the item is active.

amount.description: Amount to be charged per billing cycle, in the smallest currency unit.

Plan.description: A Razorpay Plan object used to define recurring billing.

interval.description: Number of billing periods between charges. For example, `2` with `period=weekly` means every 2 weeks.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the plan was created.

amount.description: Amount to be charged per billing cycle, in the smallest currency unit.

interval.description: Number of billing period intervals between charges. For example, `2` with `period=monthly` bills every 2 months.

count.description: Number of plans returned in this response.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier of the plan associated with this subscription.

total_count.description: Total number of billing cycles in the subscription.

paid_count.description: Number of billing cycles that have been successfully paid.

customer_notify.description: Indicates whether the customer should be notified. `1` for yes, `0` for no.

start_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the subscription starts billing.

end_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the subscription ends.

charge_at.description: Unix timestamp of the next scheduled charge.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the subscription was created.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier of the plan to subscribe to.

total_count.description: Total number of billing cycles for the subscription.

customer_notify.description: Set to `1` to notify the customer via email and SMS, `0` to suppress notifications.

start_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the subscription should start. Defaults to the current time if not provided.

quantity.description: Number of subscriptions to be charged on a single charge.

addons.description: List of add-ons to include with the subscription.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing additional information. Maximum 15 pairs, each key up to 40 characters and value up to 256 characters.

cancel_at_cycle_end.description: Set to `1` to cancel the subscription at the end of the current billing cycle. Set to `0` to cancel immediately.

count.description: Number of payment links returned in this response.
Number of subscriptions returned in this response.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response from the Razorpay API.

description.example: The amount must be greater than 0.

field.description: The field that caused the error, if applicable.

QrCode.description: A Razorpay QR Code object for UPI payments.

id.description: Unique identifier of the QR code.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the QR code was created.

name.description: Name or label for the QR code.

usage.description: Whether the QR code can be used for single or multiple payments.

type.description: Type of QR code. `upi_qr` for UPI payments.

image_url.description: URL of the QR code image. Can be embedded or downloaded.

payment_amount.description: Fixed payment amount in smallest currency unit (paise). Null for open amount QR codes.

status.description: Current status of the QR code.

fixed_amount.description: Whether the QR code has a fixed payment amount.

payments_amount_received.description: Total amount received through this QR code in smallest currency unit.

payments_count_received.description: Total number of payments received through this QR code.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing additional information.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer associated with this QR code.

close_by.description: Unix timestamp after which the QR code will be automatically closed.

closed_at.description: Unix timestamp at which the QR code was closed.

close_reason.description: Reason for closing the QR code.

type.description: Type of QR code. Use `upi_qr` for UPI payments.

name.description: Name or label for the QR code.

usage.description: Whether the QR code can be used once or multiple times.

fixed_amount.description: Set to true to create a QR code with a fixed payment amount.

payment_amount.description: Fixed payment amount in smallest currency unit (paise). Required if `fixed_amount` is true.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer to associate with this QR code.

close_by.description: Unix timestamp after which the QR code will be automatically closed.

notes.description: Key-value pairs for storing additional information. Maximum 15 pairs.

count.description: Number of QR codes returned in this response.

QrCodePaymentsResponse.description: List of payments received for a QR code.

parameters.description: Number of payment links to return. Default is 10, maximum is 100.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of payment links to skip before returning results. Used for pagination.

parameters.description: Filter by your internal reference ID.
